name: Metalfrio Solutions S.A.
summary: Metalfrio Solutions S.A., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, imports, and sells domestic and commercial refrigerators and freezers in Brazil, Turkey, Mexico, the United States, Kazakhstan, Iraq, Morocco, Paraguay, Uzbekistan, Egypt, Russia, Italy, Spain, Kenya, and internationally. The company offers horizontal and vertical freezers and refrigerators, conservators, inverters, storage units, ice cream freezers, beverage displays, coolers, breweries display and glass doors, beer max, and all black equipment under the Metalfrio, Klimasan, Derby, and Caravell brands.
